Name: Waterfall Rainbow
Author: G2GE
Description:
[center]BRING A RAINBOW TO YOUR FARM
────────────────────────
Bring a rainbow to your farm! This decorative furniture piece features a soft, semi-transparent rainbow design.
Comes in both small and large sizes. Both left and right-facing versions are included, allowing you to choose the direction that suits your setup![/center]
[center]Available from the Furniture Catalogue and Robin's shop.[/center]
[center]
This furniture cannot be placed on water. Please use the Let's Move It mod if you want to move it onto water.
Precise Furniture can be used for pixel-perfect placement adjustments.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][list]
[*]A vanilla rainbow version has also been added! If you'd like to use it, please download it separately.[/*]
[/list]Honestly, I think the vanilla rainbow looks prettier than the one I made😅
A full-farm screenshot is included in the image gallery.[/center]
